page.overview:
Who is Gluth Andoi?

Gluth Andoi was a Morseerian Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who lived during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, he was a member of the Jedi High Council and took part in the Battle of Dalna against the Path of the Open Hand. During the battle, Andoi was wounded by blaster fire and then petrified by the Leveler.

Andoi wore long Jedi robes. As a Morseerian, he also utilized a respirator mask, and wielded four lightsabers.
